mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) source_records, COALESCE(SUM(masking_status='PASS' AND is_deleted=0),0) safe_records, COALESCE(SUM(masking_status IN ('FAIL','PENDING','REVIEW_NEEDED') AND is_deleted=0),0) technical_failures FROM t_feedback_content
SELECT source_id FROM t_feedback_content WHERE source_id>#{afterId} AND masking_status='PASS' AND is_deleted=0 ORDER BY source_id LIMIT #{limit}
